title: agrostis alba var. mutica
intro: Agrostis alba var. mutica, commonly known as bent or quaking grass, is a type of grass native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis alba var. mutica include its ability to calm and sedate, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
